title: Feedback preserves the current camera
caption: Opening feedback keeps the third-person view in its screenshot, pauses movement and releases mouse capture. Closing resumes the normal camera policy.

sections.title: round4
sections.caption: Final nine openings: actual room enclosure, desktop follow/overview and phone; F8 and HUD button. Prepaused cases deliberately set pause state as a diagnostic. Screenshots retain existing HUD-compositor limitations.

sections.title: round3
